title: Retry tranche
subtitle: Every experiment that ran on the broken simulator, run again on the fixed one
why: From January to July the simulator made a proper grasp of the cube physically impossible (collision hulls filled the jaw mouth, jaw-tip sites were 15-27 mm off, the jaws closed like scissors). Every RL and VLA result from that period measured a task no policy could solve. The simulator was fixed in August (Menagerie arm model, MuJoCo pinned to 3.9, lens-matched camera, measured joint zeros). This tranche ports those methods to the current bench task and runs them under equal conditions.

experiments.title: ACT fine-tune
experiments.question: Does ACT, trained the way pi0.5 was, place the cube on unseen placements?
experiments.success_means: ACT matches or beats the CNN (6/30): the June-July ACT lane's failures were the simulator, not ACT. It also gives ACT PPO its starting policy.
experiments.label: retry-act-ft

experiments.title: SmolVLA fine-tune
experiments.question: Does a 450M VLA starting from smolvla_base learn the placement task as well as pi0.5 (3B)?
experiments.success_means: SmolVLA reaches pi0.5's held-out error and 12/30 or better: a 7x smaller VLA would do. It also gives SmolVLA ReinFlow its starting policy.
experiments.label: retry-smolvla-ft

experiments.title: pi0.5 ReinFlow
experiments.question: Does closed-loop RL fix the pi0.5 fine-tune's failures (grasp quality, about 10 mm placement scatter)?
experiments.success_means: Held-out successes above 12/30 at execute 90 (and 15/30 at execute 30) with closure error down: RL corrects what imitation could not.
experiments.label: retry-rl-pi05

experiments.title: SmolVLA ReinFlow
experiments.question: Does the January-April ReinFlow method work once grasping is possible? (Old best: 2.6% grasp rate after 21,650 episodes.)
experiments.success_means: Held-out successes above the SmolVLA fine-tune's: the old ReinFlow lane failed because of the simulator.
experiments.label: retry-rl-smolvla

experiments.title: ACT PPO
experiments.question: Does the June-July ACT PPO lane work once grasping is possible? (Old result: corner pinches only, 0% success.)
experiments.success_means: Held-out successes above the ACT fine-tune's: PPO adds what imitation lacks.
experiments.label: retry-rl-act

experiments.title: Entry 03: recovery anchors
experiments.question: Do 8 recovery examples still make the clone worse (0/15) under the right MuJoCo version?
experiments.success_means: Same verdict as under 3.11: the lesson stands. A different verdict means research-log entry 03 must be corrected.
experiments.label: retry-rerun-03-07

experiments.success_means: Same verdict: the entry stands; otherwise it is corrected.
